businesses.business: structural heart and critical care medical devices

offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells medical devices for structural heart disease, mainly transcatheter and surgical heart valves, plus hemodynamic monitoring products for critically ill and surgical patients. Sells to hospitals and cardiac care teams worldwide.

primary_products.value: transcatheter aortic heart valves; transcatheter mitral and tricuspid repair and replacement systems; surgical heart valves and repair products; hemodynamic monitoring sensors and systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, cardiac surgeons, interventional cardiologists and anesthesiologists

revenue_model.value: product sales: implantable valves, repair systems, catheters and monitoring sensors sold to hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and manufactures implantable cardiac devices and monitoring systems sold to hospitals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: transcatheter valves, surgical structural heart products and critical care monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: clinical sales teams selling to hospitals in major markets; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors in smaller international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: implantable devices requiring FDA approval, CE marking and other national regulator clearances
